intake.description: Strong winds during a storm tore off roof sheets and broke a water tank cover over the back of the house. The estimated repair cost is Rs 90,000.
intake.severity_reason: The estimated loss is between Rs 50,000 and Rs 4,99,999.

route.reason: policy number PRP-26-38841 has prefix for property; intake agent read the email as property

citations.quote: We pay for damage to the home and contents caused by storm, high winds or flood, subject to PROP-EXC-4.3.

coverage.reasoning: The claimant experienced damage to the roof sheets and water tank cover caused by strong winds during a storm on October 27, 2026. Under clause PROP-COV-2.3, damage caused by storm and high winds is a covered loss subject to the exclusions in PROP-EXC-4.3, which are not applicable here. Therefore, the claim is covered.

reasons: all citations verified against the clause text; outputs passed validation first time
